backgrounds.name: the stars' flow, true scale
backgrounds.description: The stars' own flow of space at its true scale: each star's inflow, sqrt(2GM/d), from where the star is at that moment (not where it was a light-travel time before), combined and pointing along g; g is the acceleration of space. It turns and shrinks with the stars as they spiral in.

backgrounds.name: the wave about the ring, ×8.67e+20
backgrounds.description: The flow of space the ring moves in: the binary's wave passing straight through the ring's plane - in truth 40 Mpc away along the binary's axis, drawn here beside it - a shear about the ring's centre, scaled up 8.67e+20 times as the strain is. Never added to the stars' flow, which is at its true scale.

backgrounds.name: the stars' turning flow and its seam, within 4 a
backgrounds.description: The stars' eikonal flow turning with them, at its true scale: each star carries its own flow, down zero-energy paths out of it, and their regions meet at the seam (dashed), which turns with them - the steady flow of the circular orbit they are on at each moment. It is a Newtonian flow, built in the frame turning with the stars, which moves at c about 5 orbit radii (a) out, so it is drawn only within 4 a.

layers.label: the seam, where the stars' regions of flow meet
